bull_bear.body:
- Explicit reinvestment philosophy: "The Bank is investing the profits from lending business into building the deposit, rural and other businesses" and "As the investment businesses scale up and become profitable, the overall profitability of the Bank is expected to improve from here".
- Capital adequacy at Jun-26: CET-1 ratio 13.33% and Total CRAR 15.05% (versus 13.73% and 15.60% at Mar-26), on Total Risk Weighted Assets of Rs. 3,55,232 crore; the deck notes operational risk RWA re-assessment impacted CET-1 by ~30 bps.
- Net worth has risen from Rs. 15,257 crore (Mar-18) to Rs. 48,651 crore (Jun-26); BVPS is Rs. 56.47 at Jun-26, having "increased by 80%" since Mar-21 (Rs. 31.37), after falling in the early post-merger years "due to credit losses arising from legacy corporate and infrastructure loans".
- Borrowings restructured: legacy long-term & infrastructure bonds are nil at Jun-26 (Rs. 26,819 crore at merger), with Tier II bonds of Rs. 4,500 crore and total borrowings of Rs. 33,473 crore (excluding money market borrowings).
- Stated ambition set: "Highest levels of corporate governance; Stable balance sheet growth of ~20%; Robust asset quality of GNPA less than 2% and net NPA of < 1%; High teens ROE; Contemporary technology and High levels of Customer Centricity" — against current RoA 1.06% and RoE 8.98%.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Created through the merger of IDFC Bank and Capital First on 11th December 2018; pre-merger IDFC Bank had assets of Rs. 75,332 crore as of September 30, 2018 of which 86% was in wholesale loans, while Capital First was an NBFC with AUM of Rs. 32,623 crore.
- The Bank states it has "built a full Suite of Universal Banking Products and scaled them up" spanning Retail/Rural/SME/Corporate Lending, Deposits, NRI Banking, Fastag, Trade Finance, Transaction Banking & CMS, Credit Cards, Treasury & Forex and Wealth Management.
- Claimed moat in RAM: "IDFC FIRST Bank has developed unique capabilities for 15 years to underwrite the segment profitably with stable asset quality using Cash-flow and Machine Learning model", with the RAM book grown from Rs. 94 crore (Mar-10) to Rs. 2,32,394 crore (Jun-26); the deck calls this "a long runway for growth over the next decade".
- Digital positioning: "# 1 Mobile Banking App in India, rated 4.9 on Android and 4.8 on IOS" per The Forrester Digital Experience Review: Indian Mobile Banking Apps, 2025, described elsewhere as "#1 in India (#2 globally)"; 31.4 Mn+ app registrations and 2.95 Mn+ reviews.
- Long-term credit ratings of AA+ (stable) from CRISIL, ICRA, India Ratings and CARE Ratings; CRISIL AAA on Fixed Deposits.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Fraud incident] Operating expenses of Q4 FY26 included a Rs. 646 crore fraud incident; the deck states FY26 PAT "excluding this PAT would be Rs. 2,119 crore", and FY26 C:I ratios for the overall bank and retail liabilities are shown excluding that impact.
- [CGFMU / MFI] "Bank received claims of Rs. 514.8 crore under the CGFMU scheme against MFI portfolio. The bank has created a contingency provision on a prudent basis of Rs. 515 crore for macro and geopolitical uncertainties." Disbursements since January 2024 are CGFMU-covered, with coverage at 93% of the total microfinance book as of June 30, 2026.
- [Shareholding] At June 30, 2026 the Bank had 861.47 Cr shares, held FDI/FPI/FC/FN/NRI 37.77%, MF/Insurance/Bank/FI/AIF 24.36%, Public 28.38%, President of India 7.74%, Other Body Corporate 1.68%, Trusts and Clearing Members 0.01%, Others 0.06%.
- [Leadership] MD & CEO V. Vaidyanathan took charge in December 2018 on the merger; the deck details his prior Citibank (1990-2000) and ICICI Bank (2000-2010) career and the founding of Capital First, whose retail loan book grew from Rs. 94 crore in 2010 to Rs. 29,600 crore by 2018. Board includes Narendra Ostawal (Warburg Pincus) as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director.
- [Stock] Price movement since merger cited as Rs. 37.60 (December 12, 2018) to Rs. 80.79 (July 24, 2026), a 115% change versus 81% for the NIFTY Private Bank Index.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions IDFC FIRST Bank as a post-merger universal bank pursuing the vision "To Build A World Class Bank in India with Principles of Ethical, Digital & Social Good Banking" — a retail-funded franchise (CASA ratio 50.8%, 80% of customer deposits retail) built on 15 years of cash-flow-based RAM (Retail, Agri and MSME) underwriting, now aiming for "Stable balance sheet growth of ~20%, Robust asset quality of GNPA less than 2% and net NPA of < 1%, High teens ROE".
